rules.css: font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; background: var(--paper); color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6;

position: sticky; top: 0px; z-index: 20; background: var(--ink); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 16px 8%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 0.2s;
display: inline-block; min-width: 22px; padding: 0px 6px; margin-left: 4px; background: var(--lens); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; text-align: center;
background: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 30px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); scroll-margin-top: 80px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: clamp(30px, 5vw, 48px); line-height: 1.15; max-width: 560px;
display: inline-block; background: var(--lens); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; transition: transform 0.2s;
display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px;
background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
background: var(--ink); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-color: var(--ink);
padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);
display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 18px;
background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 16px; text-align: center; transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;

background: var(--accent); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 0px; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr; gap: 28px; align-items: start;
display: block; margin: 14px 0px 6px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink);
width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(201, 208, 230); border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: rgba(91, 75, 255, 0.2) 0px 0px 0px 3px;
display: block; min-height: 20px; color: var(--err); font-size: 13px;
background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px;

position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 24px; transform: translate(-50%, 120px); background: var(--ink); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; transition: transform 0.3s; z-index: 50;
background: var(--ink); color: rgb(197, 203, 232); text-align: center; padding: 25px 15px; margin-top: 35px;
animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important;
